messages:
pagerbot: [PAGER] auth-proxy: sudden spike in 401/403s across us-west-2 + eu-central-1. rate ~2k/min, started ~10s ago. paging @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: on it. grabbing logs now. any customer impact visible?

ben_sre: I see auth failures from edge -> token validation fails upstream. Some 502s downstream but mostly 401. Correlating client ids.

carla_security: adding myself. could be leaked svc token reuse or replay. any recent deploys or key rotations?

erin_platform: no prod deploys in last 12h from CI. identity logs show repeated attempts using `svc-token-2023` from 3 distinct IPs (US, RO, EU). pattern looks like replay.

dave_custsuccess: putting together affected customer list: ACME Inc, FastApps, MedSys. error rates up for those tenants on our status board. prepping comms.

alice_oncall: quick mitigation plan: 1) block offending IPs 2) rotate svcacct token 3) fail traffic to regional fallback pool 4) notify CS + legal if leak confirmed. starting step 1.

ben_sre: applying IP blocks now (WAF). command: 
```
aws wafv2 update-ip-set --name "sus-auth-ips" --scope REGIONAL --addresses "5.6.7.8/32","87.65.43.21/32","45.77.3.9/32"
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n prod
```

alice_oncall: WAF update applied. initiating rotation for svc-token-2023. running rotation script. will roll new token to auth-proxy and then invalidate old token.

alice_oncall: rotation script output: 
"created secret svc-token-2026, updated auth-proxy secret, triggered rolling restart"
old token flagged for immediate invalidation (TTL=0) once rollout healthy.

carla_security: please snapshot logs for forensics before we purge. also request session revocation for sessions using svc-token-2023 older than 30m.

erin_platform: canary rollout started in eu-central-1, health checks passing. will push to us-west-2 in 3m if stable.

dave_custsuccess: outbound comms: status page updated, emails queued to top 3 affected customers. flagging priority support channels. no customer reports of data access yet.

ben_sre: seeing auth error rate drop ~70% after WAF + rotation but latency bump on some routes due to fallback routing. tracing shows auth microservice queue spiked temporarily. watching.

fiona_engineer: captured relevant logs + PCAP from edge nodes and uploaded to secure bucket: s3://redwood-incident-1776012345/pcap.log and s3://redwood-incident-1776012345/auth-trace.log. perms restricted.

carla_security: running quick detection queries on infra logs to hunt for token usage patterns. sample query: `index=auth_logs token=svc-token-2023 | stats count by src_ip, tenant`
if we see PII or customer data touched we'll escalate to legal.

alice_oncall: handing off ongoing watch to ben_sre (monitoring) and carla_security (forensics). dave_custsuccess continuing comms. I'll be available for questions but moving out of first responder.

ben_sre: acknowledged. will keep this thread open and escalate to infra if errors >5% for >5m.

dave_custsuccess: update at +12m: customers notified, no confirmed data exfil reports, support channels ready.

pagerbot: incident status -> MITIGATING (updated by alice_oncall) :heavy_check_mark:

alice_oncall: final notes: old token invalidated, WAF rules in place, canary -> full rollout done. monitoring trending back to normal. creating postmortem ticket and attaching collected artifacts. /me handover complete :coffee:

carla_security: will start deeper forensics now. adding timeline and indicators to the ticket.

fiona_engineer: leaving collected artifacts and quick runbook for rotation in the ticket: steps used + commands.

ben_sre: leaving monitoring dashboard links and a short-term alert rule for repeat spikes.

alice_oncall: thanks team. closing active pager for now, will reopen if recurrence.
